definitions.gloss: bamboo pole; long bamboo stick used for hanging laundry or as a tool
definitions.explanation: A long pole made of bamboo, traditionally used for hanging laundry to dry outdoors. Also used for reaching high places, fishing, and other purposes.

examples.japanese: {竿竹|さおだけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
examples.english: To hang laundry on a bamboo pole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧{竿竹|さおだけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
A compound of ⟦{竿|さお}→竿：24133_sao⟧ (pole, rod) + ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧ (bamboo). In Japan, outdoor laundry drying using {竿竹|さおだけ} or metal poles is still the norm in many households. Modern laundry poles are often made of stainless steel or aluminum rather than actual bamboo, but the word {竿竹|さおだけ} persists.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {竿竹|さおだけ}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (bamboo pole seller) is a distinctive feature of Japanese neighborhoods — trucks slowly drive through residential areas broadcasting recorded calls of 「{竿竹|さおだけ}ー」 to sell replacement laundry poles. The book 『⟦なぜ→なぜ：01484_naze⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{竿竹|さおだけ}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦つぶれない→つぶる：29078_tsuburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？』 became a bestselling business book exploring why this seemingly unprofitable business model survives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {竿竹|さおだけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: to hang (laundry) on a bamboo pole
- {竿竹|さおだけ}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: bamboo pole seller
- ⟦{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}→物干し竿：08019_monohoshizao⟧: clothes-drying pole (synonym)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}→物干し竿：08019_monohoshizao⟧: clothes-drying pole — the general term for a laundry pole, regardless of material
- {竹竿|たけざお}: bamboo pole — same characters reversed; more general, not specifically for laundry
- ⟦{竿|さお}→竿：24133_sao⟧: pole; rod — the base word, also used for fishing rods
